treatments.chemicalDefault: Consult local agricultural extension for optimal chemical dosage.
treatments.organicDefault: Ensure proper spacing and use neem-based bio-pesticides if necessary.
treatments.earlyBlightChemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Chlorothalonil @ 2g/L of water at 10-day intervals.
treatments.earlyBlightOrganic: Apply 5% neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) or Trichoderma viride spray @ 5g/L.
treatments.cottonAphidsChemical: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2g/L.
treatments.cottonAphidsOrganic: Spray 5% neem oil emulsion with soap solution or release Chrysoperla predators.
treatments.wheatRustChemical: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1ml/L of water immediately upon detection.
treatments.wheatRustOrganic: Dust sulfur powder @ 25 kg/ha or spray cow urine extract mixed with neem leaves.
treatments.healthyCropChemical: No chemical fungicide or bactericide required. Continue balanced nutrition.
treatments.healthyCropOrganic: Maintain routine soil organic matter application and preventive biological teas.
